# Settings reference

> Every `Settings` field in `ocrmd/config.py` — its `OCRMD_*` environment variable, type, built-in default and the note written beside it in the source.

Resolution order, lowest to highest precedence:

1. the defaults on `Settings`
2. `~/.config/ocrmd/config.toml`
3. `<root>/ocrmd.toml` (root = OCRMD_ROOT or the project directory)
4. environment variables `OCRMD_<FIELD>` (e.g. OCRMD_MODEL, OCRMD_STABLE_FRAMES, OCRMD_RESOLUTION=1280x960)
5. CLI options, applied by the command itself

Credentials come from `.env` (cwd, project root, then ~/.config/ocrmd/.env; first found wins and never overrides a variable already in the environment).

Values are validated on load and an invalid one fails fast, naming the key. In the environment a list may be comma-separated (`OCRMD_OCR_ENGINES=apple_vision,rapidocr`) and `OCRMD_SINKS` takes JSON. [`ocrmd.example.toml`](../../ocrmd.example.toml) is a commented starting file; `ocrmd doctor` prints the effective values.

| Setting | Environment variable | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `root` | `OCRMD_ROOT` | `Path` | `OCRMD_ROOT`, else the project directory | data lives in the repo itself (raw/, processed/, ocr/, llm/, documents/, ocrmd.db); OCRMD_ROOT overrides |

### Webcam auto-shutter

| Setting | Environment variable | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `camera_index` | `OCRMD_CAMERA_INDEX` | `int` | `0` | — |
| `analysis_width` | `OCRMD_ANALYSIS_WIDTH` | `int` | `320` | — |
| `motion_threshold` | `OCRMD_MOTION_THRESHOLD` | `float` | `4.0` | mean abs diff (0-255) below which frame is "still"; C525 sensor noise ~2.7 |
| `stable_frames` | `OCRMD_STABLE_FRAMES` | `int` | `8` | undisturbed frames before capture, after ordinary noise |
| `settle_frames` | `OCRMD_SETTLE_FRAMES` | `int` | `20` | ...and after the scene was *handled* — a hand, or the page outline moving. A page turn has to prove it has finished: the old gate fired during flips because every per-frame test can be true halfway through one (see scene.py). |
| `geometry_frames` | `OCRMD_GEOMETRY_FRAMES` | `int` | `3` | page-outline detections that must agree before the page counts as still |
| `geometry_tolerance` | `OCRMD_GEOMETRY_TOLERANCE` | `float` | `0.03` | how far it may move between them, as a fraction of the frame |
| `novelty_threshold` | `OCRMD_NOVELTY_THRESHOLD` | `int` | `12` | dHash hamming distance vs last capture |
| `blur_threshold` | `OCRMD_BLUR_THRESHOLD` | `float` | `60.0` | absolute floor for page sharpness (Laplacian variance) |
| `sharp_ratio` | `OCRMD_SHARP_RATIO` | `float` | `0.55` | ...and at least this fraction of the best this scene has shown |
| `sharp_decay` | `OCRMD_SHARP_DECAY` | `float` | `0.995` | how fast that best fades, so the bar drops when the rig changes |
| `resolution` | `OCRMD_RESOLUTION` | `tuple[int, int] \| None` | — | None = the camera's largest mode |
| `focus` | `OCRMD_FOCUS` | `str` | `"continuous"` | continuous \| locked \| settle \| off |
| `settle_after` | `OCRMD_SETTLE_AFTER` | `int` | `1` | focus=settle: lock after this many captures |

Focus is watched in the image, because the driver's own signals are useless on real webcams: `isAdjustingFocus` was false on all 599 frames measured on the rig this was built for, and `lensPosition` never left 0.0. See ocrmd/focus.py for what each of these was measured against.

| Setting | Environment variable | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `focus_recovery` | `OCRMD_FOCUS_RECOVERY` | `bool` | `true` | refocus the camera when the page has gone soft and stayed soft |
| `focus_hunt_band` | `OCRMD_FOCUS_HUNT_BAND` | `float` | `0.06` | relative sharpness spread over ~0.4s that means the lens is moving |
| `focus_soft_ratio` | `OCRMD_FOCUS_SOFT_RATIO` | `float` | `0.45` | of the best this rig has ever managed: below this it is out of focus |
| `focus_soft_frames` | `OCRMD_FOCUS_SOFT_FRAMES` | `int` | `45` | ...for this many frames in a row before anything is done (~1.5s) |
| `focus_recovery_gap` | `OCRMD_FOCUS_RECOVERY_GAP` | `float` | `6.0` | seconds between attempts, so a refocus gets time to work |
| `occlusion_cover` | `OCRMD_OCCLUSION_COVER` | `float` | `0.05` | hand gate: fraction of the reference paper area that must vanish before the frame is "covered", and how many stuck frames before a persistent intrusion is accepted as part of the scene |
| `occlusion_rebaseline` | `OCRMD_OCCLUSION_REBASELINE` | `int` | `30` | — |
| `burst_frames` | `OCRMD_BURST_FRAMES` | `int` | `3` | frames read at the shutter; the sharpest is kept (1 = off) |

Focus bracket: shoot the same still page at several lens positions and keep the extra frames as variants, so a region the sharpest frame cannot resolve can be re-read from a different focus. Needs a camera that supports locking focus at a custom lens position (`ocrmd doctor` reports it).

| Setting | Environment variable | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `focus_bracket` | `OCRMD_FOCUS_BRACKET` | `str` | `"auto"` | auto (bracket only when the frame is not the scene's best) \| always \| off |
| `focus_bracket_shots` | `OCRMD_FOCUS_BRACKET_SHOTS` | `int` | `3` | lens positions in the bracket, including the one the lens is at |
| `focus_bracket_step` | `OCRMD_FOCUS_BRACKET_STEP` | `float` | `0.05` | lens-position offset between shots, on AVFoundation's 0-1 scale |
| `focus_bracket_settle` | `OCRMD_FOCUS_BRACKET_SETTLE` | `float` | `0.25` | seconds to let the lens travel before the frame is read |
| `focus_bracket_ratio` | `OCRMD_FOCUS_BRACKET_RATIO` | `float` | `0.9` | auto: bracket when sharpness is below this share of the scene's best |
| `focus_keep` | `OCRMD_FOCUS_KEEP` | `int` | `2` | variant images kept per capture (0 = capture the bracket, keep none) |
| `capture_cooldown` | `OCRMD_CAPTURE_COOLDOWN` | `float` | `1.0` | seconds between auto captures |
| `camera_reopen_after` | `OCRMD_CAMERA_REOPEN_AFTER` | `int` | `40` | consecutive failed reads before the camera is reopened |

### Admission (should a capture become a page at all?)

Judged on what local OCR made of the crop, because image-quality signals measurably do not separate legible from illegible pages (see legibility.py). Rejection keeps the raw frame and creates nothing; it never applies to file ingest or to a forced (space-bar) capture.

| Setting | Environment variable | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `admit_captures` | `OCRMD_ADMIT_CAPTURES` | `bool` | `true` | false: every auto capture becomes a page, as before 0.6 |
| `admit_min_words` | `OCRMD_ADMIT_MIN_WORDS` | `int` | `60` | rejects 21 of the 120 scored pages, 20 of them truly illegible |
| `admit_min_confidence` | `OCRMD_ADMIT_MIN_CONFIDENCE` | `float` | `0.5` | — |

### Dedup

| Setting | Environment variable | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `near_duplicate_distance` | `OCRMD_NEAR_DUPLICATE_DISTANCE` | `int` | `10` | dHash prefilter (bits), within the same document only... |
| `near_duplicate_similarity` | `OCRMD_NEAR_DUPLICATE_SIMILARITY` | `float` | `0.985` | ...confirmed by frame correlation; different pages measure &lt;=0.98... |
| `near_duplicate_text` | `OCRMD_NEAR_DUPLICATE_TEXT` | `float` | `0.85` | ...and by OCR token overlap, so two near-blank pages stay distinct... |
| `near_duplicate_detail` | `OCRMD_NEAR_DUPLICATE_DETAIL` | `float` | `0.5` | ...falling back to high-pass image correlation when there is no OCR text |

### Preprocess

| Setting | Environment variable | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `min_page_width` | `OCRMD_MIN_PAGE_WIDTH` | `int` | `900` | px across one page below which body text is unreliable |
| `orientation_probe` | `OCRMD_ORIENTATION_PROBE` | `bool` | `false` | Decide which way up a page is by asking OCR at all four rotations. It is the only test that works — every cheaper one measures at or near chance on real captures (see preprocess.orientation_probe) — but it is OFF by default because on this machine the extra Apple Vision traffic reliably segfaults the process inside RapidOCR's ONNX detector. That is a third-party interaction, not an ocrmd bug: the same run with `ocr_engines = ["apple_vision"]` is clean. Turn it on if you do not use rapidocr, or if your platform does not show the crash. |

| Setting | Environment variable | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ocr_engines` | `OCRMD_OCR_ENGINES` | `list[str]` | `[]` | [] = auto: the best installed engine (+ a second one when ocr_ensemble) |
| `ocr_ensemble` | `OCRMD_OCR_ENSEMBLE` | `bool` | `true` | run two engines when installed and vote (see ocr.merge) |

| `ocr_min_side` | `OCRMD_OCR_MIN_SIDE` | `int` | `1400` | crops are upscaled (&lt;=3x) until the short side reaches this |
| `focus_swap_margin` | `OCRMD_FOCUS_SWAP_MARGIN` | `float` | `0.1` | a variant focus must beat the primary's line confidence by this to replace it |
| `focus_llm_images` | `OCRMD_FOCUS_LLM_IMAGES` | `int` | `2` | variant images attached to the LLM request when regions stay unresolved |

### Destinations (outbound: a read page is handed to another system)

| Setting | Environment variable | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sinks` | `OCRMD_SINKS` | `list[SinkConfig]` | `[]` | Empty disables the whole path — no button, no command, nothing leaves the machine. These are the only settings in ocrmd that send page text somewhere other than the transcription provider, so the list is empty until an operator names a receiver (see ocrmd/sinks.py and the `[[sinks]]` example in ocrmd.example.toml; OCRMD_SINKS takes the same list as JSON). |
| `web_url` | `OCRMD_WEB_URL` | `str` | `"http://127.0.0.1:8765"` | How this server refers to itself when it tells a receiver where a page image can be seen. A reviewer over there follows it back to the photograph, so it has to be reachable from a browser, not from inside a container. |

## `[[sinks]]` entries

Each destination in `sinks` (a `[[sinks]]` table in `ocrmd.toml`, or one object in the `OCRMD_SINKS` JSON list) takes these keys; the receiver contract is in `ocrmd/sinks.py`.

| Key | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `str` | **required** | — |
| `url` | `str` | **required** | — |
| `api_key` | `str` | `""` | sent as X-API-Key |
| `bearer` | `str` | `""` | sent as Authorization: Bearer … (a receiver's user token) |
| `timeout` | `float` | `120.0` | the receiver may run a model on the page; a person is waiting |
| `options` | `dict[str, Any]` | `{}` | defaults for the receiver's own options, e.g. {"section": "LR"} |
